photos.c: 27th January 1937---Part of Belgrave's winning team which beat U.S.M. (Paris) pose with Surrey's winning inter-county team at the Television studios, Alexandra Palace. But for our match in Paris coinciding with the inter-county championship, Carter,Penny,Footer and Cohen would have been included in the Surrey team. Belgravians are (l to r) rear row: W.L. Bayliss (President), A.R. Shaw. Centre row: C.T. Carter, A.W. Penny, J.A. Kemp, L.J. Cohen. Front row: A.E. Taylor, H.E. Footer. The central figure is, of course, J.C. Crump and the man on the extreme right, Denis Brickwood--then of Mitcham AC. Six days after these teams were televised by the Baird process, it was announced by the B.B.C. that the E.M.I. process would be adopted!

FLASHBACK TO 1934, shows Belgrave's cross-country runners and officials with their trophy collection which includes the London-Brighton (News of the World) Trophy, Southern and Surrey County cups. The team was also placed in the National and South of Thames Senior and Junior races.
BACK ROW (l.to r.):E.A.Duffett,R.Savage,A.T.Jordan,B.Lindsey,S.T.Ring,F.R.Webb,N.Dewberry, A. Robertshaw, W. Mitchell, A. Patience, L. Rollins.
CENTRE ROW (l. to r.):T.Eaton(masseur),D.Patience,R.Patience,J.Belchamber(Past President), W.H.Hare(Hon.Tresurer),J.R.McKay(President),W.Bayliss(General Hon.Secretary),E.Gordon(Past President),F.Walker,C.Penny,WG.Webb.
FRONT ROW (l. to r.):W.Rice,C.T.Carter,H.W.Shields,J.Flower,A.W.Penny,S.Warboys,A.Shaw, A.Taylor,[illegible].E.Footer(Captain), A.Allum.
L to R   A.Allum, H.E.Footer, A.E.Taylor, A.R.Shaw, S.Warboys Arthur Penny, J.E.Flower, H.W.Shields, Tom Carter and W.A.Rice
